summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; client_id from login then extra.client_id, client_secret from password then extra.client_secret; profile sets auth_type oauth and env-var refs for both secrets). Registered it in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py directly after DatabricksTokenProfileMapping in profile_mappings, and added it to the import and __all__ lists. Exported it from cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim, token-vs-OAuth selection, and profile output. Tests were not run, per instructions; expected values were derived by reading base.py and the token mapping. No commits made.
